n01-open
The first draft is never the last. <break time='200ms'/> The customer wants a cache. Then tighter security. Then yesterday's version back. <break time='150ms'/> Every round used to mean redrawing.
n02-title
In this episode: refining a design in plain English, with Guided Chat.
n03-draft

Here's a first draft: patient appointment booking for a regional clinic network. A web front end, a booking API, the database, documents, secrets and monitoring. <break time='120ms'/> About a hundred and nineteen dollars a month.
n04-chat
Open Guided Chat. It already knows what's on the canvas, and it suggests next steps, each tagged with the Well-Architected pillar it improves.
n05-ask
Or just say what you want, the way the customer said it: <break time='120ms'/> add a Redis cache between the booking API and the database.
n06-apply
AADB sends the current design along with the request, and changes only what was asked.
n07-review
Every reply is a change review: what was added, what was removed, and why. <break time='150ms'/> If the AI proposes anything you didn't ask for, it stops and asks before the diagram changes.
n08-canvas
On the canvas, the cache slots in between the API and the database. Everything else stays exactly where it was.
n09-cost
And the run rate follows every change.
n10-next
The suggested next steps update after every change. <break time='120ms'/> Pick one, and the same thing happens: just that change, reviewed and priced.
n10b-guard
Here the AI wanted more than the request, so it asks. Apply only what was requested, or take its suggestions.
n11-yours
It's still your diagram. <break time='120ms'/> Drag anything into the layout that tells the story best.
n12-history
And nothing is ever lost. Every change saves the version before it to the Library, with the request that changed it.
n13-restore
Try an idea with the customer. If it doesn't land, <break time='120ms'/> restore any version in one click.
n14-close
Describe it, refine it, roll it back. <break time='150ms'/> The design moves as fast as the conversation.
